notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is incorrect/missing for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The codebase already swaps from/to stations for return trips in create-reservations.mappers.ts getTripData, but the discount/promo-code amount is not similarly adjusted. mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch passes discount through as-is from dispatch.report.price.discount, which likely contains the full-order discount rather than the per-leg amount for the return dispatch. Zero-amount order handling in process-zero-amount-order.service.ts is a related but separate concern (100% promo → entire order free); this story is about partial promo amounts on return legs.

notes: Openspec provided an empty acceptanceCriteria array with helpful technical notes. I built the full AC set from scratch based on those notes and the story context. Key design decisions: (1) AC 1-2 ensure both legs of a round trip get the per-leg discount, not just the return leg — the bug likely manifests on the return but the fix should handle both legs symmetrically. (2) AC 3 is a regression guard for one-way trips. (3) AC 5 is a critical invariant: per-leg discounts must sum to the total. (4) AC 6 addresses the edge case of indivisible discount amounts. (5) AC 7 covers the zero-discount edge case. (6) AC 8 ensures the fix doesn't break the separate 100%-promo/zero-amount-order flow. (7) AC 9 ensures consistency with the existing station-swap pattern. (8) AC 10 covers the webhook entry point since http-mozio-webhook.ts is listed as a relevant file.
